content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"LPD Flight II is a shipbuilding program that funds construction of San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock ships, financed through the Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy account.","citation":{"fact_id":"cbefae17cc3ad571"}},{"text":"The LPD 17 Flight II is expected to functionally replace LSD-41 Class and LSD-49 Class ships for the embark, transport, control, insertion, sustainment, and extraction of Marine Air-Ground Task Force elements by helicopters, landing craft, and amphibious vehicles.","citation":{"fact_id":"4ec001e5c2b0f7d4"}},{"text":"Under a signed Acquisition Decision Memorandum, LPD 17 Flight II meets the Capabilities Development Document for LX(R) and subsumes all previous LX(R) efforts; the name was changed from 'Amphibious Ship Replacement LX(R)' to 'LPD 17 San Antonio Class Amphibious Transport Dock FLT II,' with LPD 30 as the first ship of the class.","citation":{"fact_id":"4ec001e5c2b0f7d4"}},{"text":"The FY 2026 request of $2.6 billion (shown as 2,600,000 in USD thousands) funds a total quantity of one ship, entirely through mandatory (reconciliation) funding rather than discretionary funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"bc9f5925ce19c0f4"}},{"text":"Within that request, $2,129,963 thousand covers full funding for the FY 2026 ship LPD 34, $195,037 thousand provides incremental funding for the FY 2025 ship LPD 33, and $275,000 thousand pays for Advance Procurement of the future LPD 35.","citation":{"fact_id":"4ec001e5c2b0f7d4"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The program's funding jumped sharply, from $500,000 thousand ($500 million) in FY 2024 actuals to a $2,600,000 thousand ($2.6 billion) FY 2026 request — more than a five-fold increase.","citation":{"fact_id":"3f9a467c9e4a73f6"}},{"text":"The FY 2026 total request stands at $2,600,000 thousand (about $2.6 billion).","citation":{"fact_id":"e0361573b0ce7727"}},{"text":"For FY 2025, the program was enacted at $1,581,121 thousand (about $1.58 billion) in the Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy account.","citation":{"fact_id":"3a86271300eb7ae4"}},{"text":"The Navy awarded a Multi-Ship Procurement contract in September 2024 for three ships (LPD 33, 34, and 35); the four-ship agreement was awarded simultaneously with LHA 10 and included Advance Procurement to acquire Long Lead Time Material plus full funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"4ec001e5c2b0f7d4"}},{"text":"Across all prior years the program totals $5,696.637 million (about $5.7 billion), indicating its cumulative scale before the FY 2026 request.","citation":{"fact_id":"909d46bbe1b2df45"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"Huntington Ingalls Incorporated is a recipient linked to this budget line through contract records.","citation":{"fact_id":"d72c23e8495ab363"}},{"text":"Huntington Ingalls Incorporated appears on additional contract records tied to this program.","citation":{"fact_id":"d2845e3890db051b"}},{"text":"Huntington Ingalls Incorporated also appears on a further contract record linked to this line.","citation":{"fact_id":"b081a16eac1edb57"}},{"text":"BAE Systems Maritime Solutions San Diego Inc. is a recipient linked to this budget line through contract records.","citation":{"fact_id":"ff6ed13f3a1678d9"}},{"text":"Raytheon Company is a recipient linked to this budget line through contract records.","citation":{"fact_id":"c54d075aeed578f1"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
